name: Southern Biscuits
author: Ian S. Pringle on based.cooking
steps: In a bowl combine dry ingredients
Cube butter and add to dry ingredients
Mix butter with hands or fork until a cornmeal consistency is achieved
Add milk and mix until homogeneous
Roll biscuits out to approx. 3/4 of an inch thick
Use a mug, cup, or cookie cutter to cut out rounds of dough
Arrange rounds in a cast iron pan
Remove from oven and eat hot
Will keep on counter or in a brisker

culture.text: A biscuit is a flour-based baked food item. Biscuits are typically hard, flat, and unleavened. They are usually sweet and may be made with sugar, chocolate, icing, jam, ginger, or cinnamon. Savoury biscuits are called crackers or biscuits for cheese.
